posts.text:
🇷🇴 WTF is going on in Romania?!?!

First, they annulled the presidential elections because anti-EU candidate Călin Georgescu won the first round... then they arrested him

Now they're going after MP George Simion, who stood in the presidential elections after Călin was banned from taking part in them

He's been summoned to attend the General Prosecutor’s Office tomorrow AS A SUSPECT!!!

Meanwhile, Călin was released from prison and placed under house arrest 2 days ago, and now they're trying to put him back behind bars

Romania struggled for years to free itself from one dictator; now it looks like they're backsliding into an EU dictatorship, where standing up for your country is punished by any and all means the state can use to silence you

This is fkn insane

Source: @georgesimion / Writer: Ian

❤️🇵🇹 Pep Guardiola: “The Portuguese Football Federation must ensure a dignified end to Cristiano Ronaldo's career”.

“Both sides need to make an effort to guarantee a fitting farewell”.

“Cristiano Ronaldo shouldn't leave the Portuguese national team in this manner”.

“They can't let him go like this”.

“He's been an incredibly important figure, not only for himself and Portugal, but for future generations of Portuguese players”.

“They must understand that Cristiano Ronaldo deserves to leave on his own terms”.

“There are exceptional players, and Cristiano Ronaldo is one of them; therefore, this situation must be rectified”.

“Whether they rectify it or not isn't my concern, but they absolutely must”.

“That's right; what he's achieved in the world of football deserves a different ending”.

“There should be a celebration where he feels the love of his countrymen, and he, in turn, must also take the initiative and say: Let's turn the page on the past”.

“An entire career shouldn't be judged based on a month or two, or because of a disagreement or misunderstanding with one or two individuals”.

“There are careers filled with achievements that deserve to be preserved and defended”.

“Great players, those who were truly at the pinnacle of their game, deserve to leave through the front door”.

“Firstly, because they earned it through everything they gave to the sport; football itself owes them this recognition”.

“And secondly, for the sake of the children taking their first steps on the pitch, who might say: I want to end my career like Romário, Cristiano Ronaldo, Lionel Messi, Paolo Maldini, or any of the other greats throughout history”.

“That's how it should be”, told @RomarioOnze.

🇺🇸🇲🇽 U.S. drones just helped Mexico capture one of the FBI's most wanted... now the Pentagon wants GM and Ford building drone parts

A US drone over Sinaloa helped Mexican troops grab "El Chapo Isidro," and now the Wall Street Journal reports the Pentagon wants GM and Ford mass-producing drone parts.

Few people alive know raids better than Rob O'Neill.

He spent years as a tier one operator with SEAL Team Six and is credited with firing the shots that killed Osama bin Laden, and even he says his kind of mission is running out of road.

A friend just back from years in Ukraine told him why:

"You can't open a door if you let a drone in."

So who wins the next war, the best operators or the most factories?

@mchooyah @WeTheBrandon

🇺🇦🇷🇺 Ukraine took its drone war to Libya with no shield at home: the Pentagon is reportedly sitting on 60 Patriot missiles Kyiv was promised

Kyiv's allies already paid for the missiles, and according to the Financial Times not one of the four batches due since September has been cleared to ship.

Anthony Aguilar, a retired Green Beret officer, says Kyiv is being punished for ignoring Washington's requests to stop hitting Russian oil refineries.

His version of the note attached to the order:

"Sorry. Maybe next week. Or maybe when you stop doing what we asked you to stop doing."

Putin has promised a painful answer for the Crimean Bridge strikes, so who pays while the paperwork waits?

Families in Kyiv will.

@WeTheBrandon
